title: Project Y.1 - World Sandbox / Free Browser Game
author: Practical-Yannic
selftext:
Hi everyone! I’ve been working on **Project Y.1 – World Sandbox**, a single-file browser game that starts with one small farm and ends somewhere in the galaxy.

What’s in the demo:

* 260+ buildings, from farms and apiaries to cities, military and space
* 300+ decisions: events, politics, research, wars, alliances
* A clean, simple surface, but tap almost any number and it shows exactly how it is calculated
* Plan wars (win chance, loot, payback) or form alliances with cities, which then expect your help
* Stock market, rivals, a built-in in-game browser, and several planets to reach

It runs right in your browser on desktop and phone. This is an early demo, so balance is still a work in progress, and I’d love to hear what feels good, what’s confusing, and what you want to see next.

Play here: [Project Y.1](https://yj-studios.itch.io/project-y1-world-sandbox)

*AI disclosure: This game was built with the help of AI (Claude by Anthropic). I designed the game and made the decisions; the AI wrote much of the code and helped with the page and promo video.*
